text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A media interview had been scheduled, and preparations were underway, but—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: You seem kind of down today... are you okay?
You seem a little down today, don't you...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: During interviews, Duramente carries herself with dignified grace, befitting a member of a prestigious lineage... but today, she seems somewhat out of spirits.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...No.
...I'm going to go wash my face for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Her steps seem somewhat heavy.
Could it be fatigue from the previous race?
I might need to rethink the schedule a bit."
